entries.title: Job 32:1
segments: ¶So these three men gave no more answers to Job, because he seemed to himself to be right.

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was angry, burning with wrath against Job, because he seemed to himself more right than God;

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: And he was angry with his three friends, because they had been unable to give him an answer, and had not made Job's sin clear.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: Now Elihu had kept quiet while Job was talking, because they were older than he;

entries.title: Job 32:5
segments: And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of the three men, he was very angry.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: ¶And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, made answer and said, I am young, and you are very old, so I was in fear, and kept myself from putting my knowledge before you.

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: I said to myself, It is right for the old to say what is in their minds, and for those who are far on in years to give out wisdom.

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: But truly it is the spirit in man, even the breath of the Ruler of all, which gives them knowledge.

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: It is not the old who are wise, and those who are full of years have not the knowledge of what is right.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments: So I say, Give ear to me, and I will put forward my knowledge.

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments: I was waiting for your words, I was giving ear to your wise sayings; while you were searching out what to say,

entries.title: Job 32:12
segments: I was taking note; and truly not one of you was able to make clear Job's error, or to give an answer to his words.

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: Take care that you do not say, Wisdom is here; God may overcome him, but not man.

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: I will not put forward words like these, or make use of your sayings in answer to him.

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: ¶Fear has overcome them, they have no more answers to give; they have come to an end of words.

entries.title: Job 32:16
segments: And am I to go on waiting while they have nothing to say? while they keep quiet and give no more answers?

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments: I will give my answer; I will put forward my knowledge:

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments: For I am full of words, I am unable to keep in my breath any longer:

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: My stomach is like wine which is unable to get out; like skins full of new wine, it is almost burst.

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: Let me say what is in my mind, so that I may get comfort; let me give answer with open mouth.

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: Let me not give respect to any man, or give names of honour to any living.

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: For I am not able to give names of honour to any man; and if I did, my Maker would quickly take me away.
